purpose: Tag appearance and suitability independently of structural/functional verification
rules: Names alone never establish semantic roles or approved design families.
One mesh may contain disconnected components; grouping and splitting require visual topology review.
All donor transforms and material maps retain original source identity.
Never treat greeble decorative geometry as validated Factorio fluid ports or collision interfaces.
Evaluate visual benefit at the actual projected sprite resolution and view angle.
Keep original asset unchanged; fit-to-purpose edits are derived revisions with their own hashes.

material_policy.asset_conversion: geometry-first, strip placeholders from derived .blend candidate
material_policy.retargeting: approved FMPL material profiles assigned after visual classification and shading review
